name: Gyakuten Majo Saiban -Yasashii Takaho Onee-chan wa Majo Chijo Bitch-
original_name: 逆転魔女裁判 －優しい貴穂お姉ちゃんは魔女・痴女・ビッチ－
source: Mikoto was bullied for being feminine since childhood and finds solace in the protection of his admired childhood friend, Takaho. One day, Mikoto is saved by Takaho's suspicious witch ritual, only to discover that she is a modern-day witch. However, this attracts the attention of other witches, leading to Mikoto being subjected to an unfair Reverse Witch Trial dictated by the rules of the witch community. Raja, a beautiful but authoritative witch, becomes the judge of this case, with Takaho serving as his lawyer.
translation: 御琴从小就因为举止女性化而遭到欺负，唯一的慰藉是仰慕的青梅竹马贵穗的保护。某天，御琴被贵穗可疑的巫术仪式救下，却发现她原来是现代巫师。然而，这引起了其他巫师的注意，御琴也因此受到巫师社会规则支配的不公正“逆转魔女审判”。美丽而威严的巫师拉贾担任此案的审判长，贵穗则作为御琴的律师出庭。
